exam.title: Design and Technology Paper 1 (17/1) - October/November 2023
exam.subject: Design and Technology
exam.description: Botswana Examinations Council, Junior Certificate Examination. Answer all 40 questions. Four possible answers are given for each question; choose the one you think is correct.

questions.question: Which method of conversion is illustrated below?
questions.explanation: The log is cut into parallel slices straight through from one side to the other. This is plain (through-and-through) sawing, the quickest and least wasteful way to convert a log. Quarter and radial sawing cut the log into quarters first.

questions.question: Which of the following is a manufactured board?
questions.explanation: Plywood is made by gluing thin veneers together, so it is a manufactured board. Jelutong and meranti are natural hardwoods.

questions.question: Which of the following plastics is suitable for making external sign boards?
questions.explanation: Acrylic weathers well outdoors, comes in clear and coloured sheet, and can be cut, bent and printed on, which makes it the usual plastic for signs.

questions.question: The figure shows a holding tool. What is the tool used for?
options: Holding work piece in place while crosscutting
For holding large boards during gluing
questions.explanation: This is a sash clamp. Its long bar lets it reach across wide panels and frames, so it is used to hold boards together while the glue sets.

questions.question: The figure shows a Covid-19 sign post. Which of the following materials can be used for making the sign post?
questions.explanation: A sign post that stands outside and is carried by its handle needs to be light and resist corrosion. Aluminium is both, and is cheaper than stainless steel. Mild steel would rust.

questions.question: The figure shows a Covid-19 sign post. Which of the following can be used for marking out the circular part?
questions.explanation: Spring dividers scratch arcs and circles onto metal. A pair of compasses is used with a pencil on paper or wood, and odd leg callipers mark lines parallel to an edge.

questions.question: The figure shows a Covid-19 sign post. Which finish will be suitable to be used for the sign post?
questions.explanation: Paint protects metal from the weather and gives the bright colours a sign needs. Oil, polish and varnish are mainly wood finishes.

questions.question: The figure shows a Covid-19 sign post. Which drill bit will be suitable for making holes for the handle?
questions.explanation: A twist bit drills small holes in metal, such as the holes for fixing the handle. An auger bit is for wood, a masonry bit for brick and concrete, and a hole saw cuts large holes.

questions.question: The diagram shows a file. What is the name of the file?
questions.explanation: The close-up shows the cross-section: one flat face and one curved face. That shape is a half round file. A rasp has coarse individual teeth and is used on wood.

questions.question: What is the function of a tang in a file?
options: For preventing the handle from splitting
questions.explanation: The tang is the pointed end of the file that fits into the handle. A file must never be used without a handle, or the tang can injure the hand.

questions.question: Which adhesive is appropriate for joining a wooden toy?
questions.explanation: PVA is the standard wood glue. It forms a strong joint, is non-toxic once dry and is safe for a child's toy.

questions.question: What factor should be considered when selecting chisels for a particular job?
options: The shape of work to be chiselled
questions.explanation: Each kind of chisel suits a shape of cut: a bevel edge chisel for dovetails and corners, a mortise chisel for deep slots, and a gouge for curves. So the shape of the work decides which chisel to use.

questions.question: What type of force is displayed by the diagram below?
questions.explanation: The arrows turn the two ends in opposite directions and the block is twisted. A twisting force is torsion.

questions.question: Which type of mechanism is displayed by the stapler shown below?
questions.explanation: A stapler is a lever: the top arm turns about the hinge at the back, and pressing the end pushes the staple through.

questions.question: Which of the following tools is used for checking squareness and flatness on a wooden board?
questions.explanation: A try square checks that a wooden edge is at 90° and that a surface is flat. An engineer's square does the same job on metal.

questions.question: Which of the following is a percussion tool?
questions.explanation: Percussion tools work by striking. A wooden mallet is used to strike chisels and tap joints together.

questions.question: The diagram shows a shearing tool. Which of the labelled parts is the pivot?
questions.explanation: X is the rivet where the two blades cross and turn. That is the pivot (fulcrum) of the snips.

questions.question: Which of the following shows construction of a perpendicular line?
questions.explanation: B erects a perpendicular from a point on line EF: arcs are struck from the point and their crossing gives a line at 90° to EF. A shows a parallel line and D bisects an angle. C bisects EF, which also gives a perpendicular, but B is the standard construction of a perpendicular from a point.

questions.question: Which of the following are components of an advertising strategy?
options: Name, features, benefits of the product
questions.explanation: An advert tells customers the product's name, its features and how it will benefit them.

questions.question: Which of the following diagrams shows a line divided into ratio 3 : 2?
questions.explanation: To divide a line in the ratio 3 : 2, step off five equal divisions on the construction line, join the last one to X, and draw a parallel line from the third division. A does this. In B the line comes from the second division (2 : 3), in C from the first (1 : 4), and in D from the fourth (4 : 1).

questions.question: What is the name of the quadrilateral shown below?
questions.explanation: The arrow marks show both pairs of opposite sides are parallel, and the corners are not right angles, so the shape is a parallelogram.

questions.question: Which of the following statements defines the specification of an educational toy?
options: It should have a mechanism that allows movement.
A cost of maximum of P500 to be used to manufacture it.
It should encourage the child to learn and develop new skills.
The toy should be light in weight so that it can be carried around.
questions.explanation: What makes a toy educational is that it helps the child learn. That is the specification that defines its purpose; the others could apply to any toy.

questions.question: What is a design research?
options: Identifying something precisely or stating a precise requirement
Searching for information to carry out design situation
A simple idea thought of at the start of the project
A thing that is difficult to achieve
questions.explanation: Research means searching for information that helps the designer understand the situation and design a good solution.

questions.question: Which instrument is used for carrying out research?
questions.explanation: A questionnaire collects information from users. Adverts, billboards and television are used to promote a product.

questions.question: Which of the following is used to calculate voltage?
questions.explanation: Ohm's law: voltage equals current multiplied by resistance, V = I × R.

questions.question: If there are 7 amps running through a 3-ohm resistor, what will be the voltage across the resistor?
questions.explanation: Using V = I × R: 7 A × 3 Ω = 21 V.

questions.question: Which of the following plastics is transparent in colour?
questions.explanation: Polyester casting resin sets clear, which is why it is used to embed objects in transparent blocks. Urea and melamine formaldehyde are opaque.

questions.question: How is wood prepared for finishing?
options: By using glass paper along the grains
By applying primer on the wooden surface
By using wood filler to make the surface smooth
questions.explanation: Wood is smoothed with glass paper wrapped round a cork block, rubbing along the grain. Sanding across the grain leaves scratches that show through the finish.

questions.question: What happens when small drill bits are run at a slow speed?
questions.explanation: Small bits must run fast. At a slow speed the operator pushes harder to make it cut, and the thin bit bends and snaps.

questions.question: Which method of drawing is shown below?
questions.explanation: The edges of the box run back to two vanishing points, P and Q, on the horizon line. That is two-point perspective.

questions.question: Which enhancing technique is shown in the diagram below?
questions.explanation: Each face is given a different shade of grey, from light to dark, to show how the light falls on it. Using shades of one tone like this is tone shading.

questions.question: The diagram shows an isometric block. Which of the following represents the front view of the object, seen in the direction of arrow F?
questions.explanation: Seen from F, the two ridges appear as trapezoids with a V between them and the back plate as a strip on the right, which rules out B and D. The channel cut into the front ridge is hidden behind it in this view, so its floor is shown with a dashed hidden-detail line. Only C shows that line.

questions.question: What do the short dash lines represent in working drawings?
questions.explanation: Short dashed lines show edges hidden from view. Centre lines are long chain lines and outlines are thick continuous lines.

questions.question: What are the different grades of abrasive papers?
questions.explanation: Abrasive papers are graded by grit size: coarse, medium, fine and extra fine. Rough, bastard, smooth and dead smooth are grades of files.

questions.question: Which materials can be suitable to produce the model structure below?
questions.explanation: Balsa wood is light, easy to cut and glue, and strong for its weight, so it is used for model bridges. Dowel can be used for round parts.

questions.question: Which of the following images shows the use of electricity?
questions.explanation: A shows pylons and power lines carrying electricity. B uses firewood, C is a gas cylinder, and D is a well worked by hand.

questions.question: A farmer has difficulty lifting bags of maize and loading them into his vehicle. As a designer you are to design and make a product to help him lift the bags. Which mechanism will be appropriate to use in the design of the product?
questions.explanation: A pulley system is the usual mechanism for lifting loads: it changes the direction of the pull and, with more pulleys, reduces the effort needed.

questions.question: Which of the following materials are suitable for making the swing shown below?
questions.explanation: The frame is made of metal rods, the seats hang on chains, and the seats are boards. All three are strong enough to carry a child safely.

questions.question: Which energy source would be appropriate to use for cooking in the bush when camping?
questions.explanation: In the bush there is no electricity or biogas supply, and wind cannot cook food. Firewood is available on the spot.

questions.question: What type of screw slot will the screwdriver below be used on?
questions.explanation: The screwdriver has a flat, straight blade tip, so it fits a slotted (flat) screw head.
